events.content:
Added a notification toggle to the Settings page. The [Server Action](/workspace/app/actions.ts:8) saves the preference in a cookie and calls Next.js’s `refresh()` from `next/cache`, so the [page](/workspace/app/page.tsx:4) shows the updated value without navigating elsewhere. I also added the required [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:1).

`npm run build` passes. Runtime checks toggled the display from off to on and back at `/`; both responses were HTTP 200 with no `Location` header.

The preference is stored per browser because this scaffold has no user account or settings store.
